title: WeatherGlass AI
text:
WeatherGlass AI

notes:
Inbound trial signup via self-serve. Small engineering team, building an insurance claims support assistant. Interested only in hosted API for now (na region). Primary pain: streaming responses + function/tool calling + structured JSON output. Using Node SDK (axios fallback).

Call highlights (03/03):
- Eli: 'we want streaming to update UI progressively but need parseable JSON for downstream toolchain'
- Described repeated failures where streaming chunks split JSON objects and their parser throws. Also saw 'function schema' mismatch: Redwood's returned function args come back with changed field order/types vs their schema validator => autounwrap fails.
- They tested JSON mode (assistant->JSON) and observed extra trailing commas in some runs when model streamed -> client JSON.parse fails.
- Low cost tolerance, pref on-by-default open-source models but flexible. Latency target: p95 < 450ms for single-turn small prompts; throughput modest (5-15 qps burst).

What we tried / shared:
- Shared quick repro: Node fetch streaming example + their parser. They attached snippet to Gmail thread.
- Sent security FAQ + pricing deck (drive).
- Opened internal ticket INF-3421 to replicate streaming chunk boundary behavior.
- Suggested temporary workaround: buffer full response server-side (non-streaming) then validate JSON before client; acceptable short-term but negates streaming benefit.

Customer quote: 'If we can't get reliable JSON function outputs with streaming, we'll need to fallback to polling — defeats purpose.'

Notes on fit: good PLG motion, small ARR potential but could expand to Dedicated as scale/SLAs grow. Currently exploratory, wants reproducible steps and small config fixes they can toggle from dashboard.
